desc: If H == 1 or W == 1, handle as 1D product case.
Implement make_matrix(vec) to build the lower‑triangular matrix for a single vector (O(n²)).
Implement combine(left, right) to multiply right * left using the O(n²) recurrence.
Build a segment tree over the m = max(H,W) vectors; leaves store make_matrix(vec), internal nodes store combine of children.
For each update: move position, update the grid and the corresponding vector, recompute the leaf matrix, and update the segment tree path (O(log m) combines).
After each update, output the (n‑1,0) entry of the root matrix.
Optimize inner loops (local variables, precomputed row offsets) for speed.
